name: Gujarat Hotels Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Gujarat Hotels Ltd is an associate company of ITC Limited which operates in Tourism & Hospitality sector.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ITC Limited holds 45.78% in Gujarat Hotels Limited. Company owns the Welcome Hotel Vadodara in Vadodara which is operated by ITC Limited under an Operating Licence Agreement

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 19.8%
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 11.2% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.52 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 150 days.
